fields.name: Doubleblast Passionfruit
fields.source:
发射可以腐蚀头戴防具的酸性果籽，大招发射的果籽更可缩小僵尸。
<color=blue>SHUTTLE版联动植物</color>

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>普通攻击和大招发射的百香果籽均会附加目标一类防具当前血量0.2倍的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>大招：</color><color=red>消耗3000金钱，冷却2秒。发射一颗伤害40的巨型百香果籽，造成伤害后，使目标缩小（体型和血量变为0.7倍）</color>
fields.previous:
Doubleblast Passionfruit is a floating passionfruit that fires seeds at enemies.

<color=blue>SHUTTLE Collab Plant</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Flying plant.
<color=black>•</color> Each hit deals an extra damage equal to 10% of the zombie's max Toughness to the zombie's headgear armor (Type 1).
<color=black>Ultimate: </color>Costs 3000 Coins, Cooldown: 2s; launches a giant passionfruit seed that deals damage to armor equivalent to 20% of current HP.</color>
fields.english:
Doubleblast Passionfruit is a floating passionfruit that fires seeds at enemies.

<color=blue>SHUTTLE Collab Plant</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Flying plant.
<color=black>•</color> Normal and Ultimate seeds deal additional damage equal to 20% of the target's current Type 1 armor HP.
<color=black>Ultimate: </color>Costs 3000 Coins, Cooldown: 2s; launches a giant passionfruit seed with 40 base damage. After dealing damage, it shrinks the target, reducing its size and HP to 70%.</color>
reasons: Revalidated official 4.1 source and prior factual review: Official damage interval is 3 seconds. Official 4.0.5 source and stale PC text still match the reviewed correction.
Official description and Bullet_passionFruit.HitZombie use current-armor fraction 0.2, not max-HP fraction 0.1.
Bullet_passionFruit giant-seed path uses shrink factor 0.7; preserve base damage and armor effect.

fields.name: Icicle-shroom
fields.source:
发射施加寒冷状态的小冰锥。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/2.25秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>低矮，可密植</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击能穿透2次，施加寒冷状态，赋予5点冻结值。对冻结或免疫0级寒冷状态的僵尸伤害×4</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>小喷菇（底座）+豌豆射手+寒冰菇</color>
fields.previous:
Icicle-shroom fires icicles that slow down and pierce enemies.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Inflicts chill and adds 5 Cryo points for every icicle hit. Pierce 2 times. Deals ×4 damage to frozen and chill-immune zombies.</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Short plant (evades straight-firing projectiles).</color>

fields.name: Cob-pult
fields.source:
投出玉米瓜或能范围定身的黄油瓜。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有25%概率投出160伤害的黄油瓜，使直击的目标定身4秒，使溅射范围内的僵尸定身(4/溅射总数)秒，最低0.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>西瓜投手+玉米投手</color>
fields.previous:
Cob-pult throws large corns at the zombies; sometimes they're buttered, which can immobilize all zombies in an area!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120/3s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Has a 1/4 chance to throw a Buttered Corn with 140 damage, immobilizing the main target for 4 seconds and zombies in the splash range for (4 / total splash spread) seconds (minimum of 0.5).</color>

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>射程4.5格。不攻击时蓄力至少4.5秒，发射时使子弹伤害增至（1+蓄力时间×0.5）倍，蓄力上限30秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+西瓜投手</color>
fields.previous:
Spring Melon charges its attack when no zombies are near, then uses that energy to launch a powerful melon when they get close!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>120/4s</color>
<color=black>Range:</color><color=#8B0000> 4 tiles ahead</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>Charges when not attacking for at least 4.5s to increase damage to (1 + charge time × 0.5) times the base damage. Maximum charge time: 30s.</color>

fields.name: Squash Pumpkin
fields.source:
窝瓜的温馨小窝，能使壳内的特定植物召唤迷你窝瓜。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>在陆地上时，壳内的窝瓜类植物不会索敌</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>在陆地上时，每2.5秒使壳内特定植物生产迷你窝瓜，每个窝瓜南瓜生成的迷你窝瓜只能同时存在一个</color>
<color=#3D1400>迷你窝瓜：①</color><color=red>索敌范围为自身所在位置至右侧1.1格，攻击最多6次后消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>根据生成者的品种，落地时有不同的伤害和效果：</color>
<color=#A86A44>·窝瓜类植物或窝瓜坚果：</color><color=red>伤害为生成者攻击力的1/8</color>
<color=#A86A44>·西瓜窝窝投手：</color><color=red>落地时生成一个西瓜，两者的伤害均等于生成者攻击力</color>
<color=#A86A44>·玉米窝窝投手：</color><color=red>落地时有25%概率生成一个黄油，两者的伤害均等</color>于生成者攻击力
<color=#A86A44>·窝瓜火炬树桩：</color><color=red>伤害为225</color>
<color=#A86A44>·究极火爆窝炬：</color><color=red>伤害为1800，落地时释放火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#A86A44>·核爆窝瓜：</color><color=red>该迷你窝瓜可同时存在多个。每次落地释放樱桃炸弹效果，第6次落地额外释放一圈（12个）核能爆破子弹，伤害均为生成者攻击力的1/8</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>南瓜（底座）+窝瓜</color>
fields.previous:
Squash Pumpkin can take the attack properties of Squash plants inside and use them to summon Squash minions!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>225</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Squash plants in Squash Pumpkins lose their ability to detect enemies.
<color=black>•</color> When there are Squash or Squashwood plants in Squash Pumpkin, a baby squash with a maximum jump distance of 1.5 tiles is spawned and jumps forward, damaging zombies when it lands. It disappears after 6 jumps and regenerates 3s after the last baby squash disappears.
<color=black>•</color> Depending on the type of Squash inside it, the baby squashes have different effects:
- Squashes and Squash-nut: Baby squash does 1/8 the original damage.
- Gourd-pult: Baby squash drops a melon on landing that does the same damage.
- Squashwood: Baby squash does 225 damage.
- Butternut-pult: Baby squash has a 25% chance to drop a butter on landing that does the same damage.
- Infernal Squashwood: Baby squash does 1800 damage and releases a Jalapeno effect each time it lands.
- Big Crunch Squash: Baby squash releases a Cherry Bomb effect each time it lands and also a ring of 12 pieces of Cosmic Debris the last time. Both do 1/8 the original damage.
<color=black>•</color> Abilities do not work in water lanes.</color>
fields.english:
Squash Pumpkin can take the attack properties of Squash plants inside and use them to summon Squash minions!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>225</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Squash plants in Squash Pumpkins lose their ability to detect enemies.
<color=black>•</color> When there are Squash or Squashwood plants in Squash Pumpkin, a baby squash is summoned every 2.5 seconds, with at most one active at a time per Squash Pumpkin. It detects zombies up to 1.1 tiles to its right, damages them when it lands, and disappears after 6 attacks.
<color=black>•</color> Depending on the type of Squash inside it, the baby squashes have different effects:
- Squashes and Squash-nut: Baby squash does 1/8 the original damage.
- Gourd-pult: Baby squash drops a melon on landing that does the same damage.
- Squashwood: Baby squash does 225 damage.
- Butternut-pult: Baby squash has a 25% chance to drop a butter on landing that does the same damage.
- Infernal Squashwood: Baby squash does 1800 damage and releases a Jalapeno effect each time it lands.
- Big Crunch Squash: Multiple baby squashes can be active at once. Baby squash releases a Cherry Bomb effect each time it lands and also a ring of 12 pieces of Cosmic Debris the last time. Both do 1/8 the original damage.
<color=black>•</color> Abilities do not work in water lanes.</color>
reasons: Revalidated official 4.1 source and prior factual review: Official text says every 2.5 seconds, one active per shell except the named variant, target range 1.1 tiles to the right and 6 attacks. Existing PC names retained. Official 4.0.5 source and stale PC text still match the reviewed correction.

fields.name: Hungry-shroom
fields.source:
害怕时吞下周围僵尸，并在威胁解除后吐出尸块来攻击。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>害怕时，对3×3范围内最多3只僵尸造成吞食。不论成功与否，该效果进入40秒冷却，期间发射无限穿透的滚地尸块</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>胆小菇+大嘴花</color>
fields.previous:
When scared, Hungry-shroom swallows nearby Zombies and spits out chunks of corpses to attack once the threat has passed.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>When scared, swallows up to 3 Zombies within a 3×3 area. This effect then enters a 40s CD, during which it fires ground-rolling chunks of corpses with infinite pierce.</color>
